Tanukhid and Jazygian wars cannot empty every other frontier.

Variants.Content: Field armies, frontier guards, forts and transports support each other. Infantry, cavalry and siege forces need different supplies; Tanukhid and Jazygian wars cannot empty every other frontier.

Eastern field armies, frontier guards, forts and transports support one another. These forces remain limited by food, rest and loads; vanguard speed does not represent the whole column. Tanukhid and Jazygian wars cannot empty every other frontier.

Tanukhid and Jazygian wars cannot empty every other frontier. Usable strength includes supply, home guards and exits; concentration reduces another reserve. Eastern field armies, frontier guards, forts and transports support one another.

Eastern field armies, frontier guards, forts and transports support one another. Fighters come from households; prolonged loss of labor or animals weakens the next levy. Tanukhid and Jazygian wars cannot empty every other frontier.

Tanukhid and Jazygian wars cannot empty every other frontier. Repair, carrying and care also use people, while daily supply continues after troops pass. Eastern field armies, frontier guards, forts and transports support one another.
